name: Price & Cart Hider – WooCommerce Catalog Mode, Wholesale & B2B
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Price & Cart Hider is the ultimate solution to transform your WooCommerce store into a flexible Catalog Mode, Wholesale, or B2B store. Effortlessly hide prices and “Add to Cart” buttons based on your own rules—by product, category, or tag—without writing a single line of code.

Whether you need a simple catalog website, a members-only shop, or a private wholesale portal, this plugin handles it all. It is ideal for store owners who want to disable checkout, hide prices for guest users, or run a wholesale or B2B WooCommerce catalog.

Need help? Email contact@versesofts.com

🔥 Key Features

  • WooCommerce Catalog Mode: Easily turn your store into a catalog by identifying products and removing purchasing options.
  • Hide Prices Anywhere: Remove or hide product prices globally or for specific items.
  • Hide Add to Cart Button: Disable purchasing while keeping your product catalog visible.
  • Wholesale & B2B Ready: Perfect for hiding prices from guest users while showing them to logged-in customers.
  • Custom Replacement Text: Display calls to action like “Login to View Price”, “Call for Price”, or “Contact Us for Pricing”.
  • Flexible Rule System: Apply settings to specific Products, Categories, or Tags.
  • Exclude Specific Products: Keep control over visibility for selected products (e.g., show prices for accessories but hide for main units).
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built with performance and simplicity in mind—won’t slow down your site.
  • Theme Compatible: Works seamlessly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes (Astra, OceanWP, Divi, etc.).

🎯 Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores – Hide wholesale prices from retail visitors.
  • Catalog-Only Websites – Display your full product range without ecommerce functionality.
  • B2B Marketplaces – Offer specific pricing for logged-in business partners.
  • Membership-Based Shops – Restrict pricing and purchasing to registered members only.
  • Private Pricing Models – Offer exclusive prices to select users.
  • Pre-Launch Stores – Show products before they are available for purchase.

🚀 Professional Tools

  • Smart visibility management
  • Intuitive and modern admin interface
  • Full compatibility with WooCommerce standards
  • Optimized, clean, and secure code
  • Customizable replacement messages
  • Works well with caching and optimization plugins

Additional Information

For feedback or assistance, email contact@versesofts.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Price & Cart Hider”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to configure your settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the entire price-cart-hider folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to begin setup
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices for specific products only?

Yes! You can target individual products, entire categories, or product tags for full control.

Can I show a custom message instead of hiding the price?

Absolutely. Replace the hidden price with any message — for example, “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Pricing”.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, Price & Cart Hider works perfectly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes! It’s built with optimized, minimal code that ensures top performance without slowing down your site.

Where can I get support?

We offer support via email:
* Email: contact@versesofts.com
